purpose: Displays content that requires user attention or action in a layer above the page. Blocks interaction with the page behind it until the user responds or dismisses the modal.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Controls whether the modal is visible

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the modal

props.name: title
props.description: Modal heading, used as the accessible dialog name

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant. danger uses warning colours for destructive actions. Defaults to default

props.name: footer
props.description: Action buttons rendered in the modal footer

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Dismisses the modal when the overlay is clicked. Defaults to true

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Element that receives focus when the modal opens. Defaults to the first focusable element

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading status in the body and sets aria-busy on the dialog

whenToUse: To confirm a destructive action before it executes
To gather a small amount of information from the user without navigating away from the current page
To show critical information that requires the user to acknowledge before continuing
whenNotToUse: For long-form content or multi-step flows — use a dedicated page or drawer
As a notification or toast — use an alert or toast component instead
When the user does not need to take action — use an inline message or tooltip
antiPatterns: Opening a modal from inside another modal — stack modals never more than one deep
Omitting a title — every modal needs a visible heading for screen readers
Blocking the user without offering a way to dismiss

anatomy: Scrim, panel with header (title, close IconButton), body and footer actions
states: Panel at `elevation-4` with a 1px `color-border-default`; scrim `color-background-overlay` at `opacity-overlay`
motion: Scrim and panel fade in over `motion-duration-overlay` with `motion-easing-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Must set aria-labelledby pointing to the modal title element
Must trap focus within the modal while open — no Tab escape
Must restore focus to the trigger element when closed
Escape key must close the modal
Overlay must have role='presentation' and not be focusable
